notes.title: An Award, an Expo, and a Demo?! 🐾
notes.content:
Hi, Chefs!



We've got some exciting news for Dogwood! 


First off, we are incredibly honored and humbled to announce that Dogwood has won an award at the Young Creatives Challenge Season 2 competition! We are so grateful for this recognition and want to extend a huge thank you to the judges, contestants, and all of you, who has supported us on this journey.  As for other news... 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596770/f13ab7b2053bb36cdd04364581838db32a81d1a3.png"]
Come See Us at PGDX!


That's right! Team Soleil will have a booth at the Philippine GameDev Expo (PGDX) from July 25-27, 2025, at the SMX Convention Center Manila.   



We first attended PGDX two years ago and thought: "We'll be there with them one day." And now we will! 



Come by our booth to say hi and play our exclusive demo of Dogwood. We've got a lot of never-before-seen content for it and we'd love to experience it with you.    



Here's a little concept art of the brand-new town we're working on:  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596770/cb459d8e88d86f151cdb209626d7bde4cd28ce08.png"]

Thank you once again for your continual support. It means a lot to us that you're sticking with us in this journey.   


Wishlist and follow Dogwood here on Steam and our socials below to get all the latest updates!   


With all our thanks, 

Team Soleil🌻
